neighbours.label: the means or condition that makes a signal or perception stronger: 'strong' light, 'through' amplification or contrast
fire: Fine scratches on the lens only show up in strong sunlight.
The sensor gains sensitivity through careful amplification of weak signals.

The new antenna improves reception through better amplification.
The painting's colors are most vivid in strong daylight.
Doctors can see the tumor more clearly through contrast dye.
The faint signal became audible through a small amplifier.
Cracks in the glass are visible only under strong lamps.

The sensor was installed on the roof last summer.
The old map was sold at auction for a high price.
The new antenna was painted grey to match the roof.
The painting's frame was made of carved oak.

notes: Output promotes amplify/sharpen/heightened/intens. Card: 'with strong sunlight', 'sensitivity through signal amplification', 'best seen when it is'. Probes 0.27-0.42 on strong/through.
